findings.title: /api/performance has slow and variable bounded-response behavior
findings.evidence: One bounded recovery smoke returned TIMEOUT_OR_FAIL_28 for /api/performance at 45 seconds while /performance rendered 200; the later representative audit smoke returned 200 in 37.2 seconds.
findings.impact: Performance data exists, but API consumers can approach or exceed route budgets depending on runtime/database conditions.
findings.recommendedRepair: Profile /api/performance query fan-out; add date/sport bounds, precomputed summaries or shared cached snapshot after audit.

findings.title: Vercel optimized build OOM remains unresolved
findings.evidence: Local build passes with 386 static pages; prior Vercel Standard build fails during optimized production build from memory pressure.
findings.impact: Automatic deployment after push may fail even when code validation passes.
findings.recommendedRepair: Continue Build Memory Optimization Phase B/C using import graph and route tracing; avoid product behavior changes.

findings.title: Historical settled status and deterministic result counts diverge
findings.evidence: Read-only counts show MLB result-based settled 944 while raw settled-like status is higher due older audit rows carrying win/loss/push status without deterministic result.
findings.impact: Product surfaces using status instead of result can overstate performance or learning samples.
findings.recommendedRepair: Standardize performance/settlement counts on deterministic result in win/loss/push and document legacy status rows.

findings.title: Learning labels are derived evidence, but several docs/scripts still imply standalone learning label rows
findings.evidence: Data coverage says learning labels are derived/evidence-scoped; AI Operations builds a read-only queue from prediction_history; no standalone canonical row count is claimed.
findings.impact: Operators may look for a nonexistent learning_labels table or assume label writes are missing.
findings.recommendedRepair: Rename reporting to derived learning evidence unless a dedicated table is approved later.

findings.title: Settlement readiness exists in multiple services with different evidence boundaries
findings.evidence: Operating-day settlement uses canonical game_results; Settlement Reconciliation V2 stores compatibility lifecycle metadata; adaptive scheduler also classifies backlog for action choice.
findings.impact: Small differences can cause scheduler/action mismatch or confusing backlog counts.
findings.recommendedRepair: Extract a shared canonical settlement-readiness helper and keep reconciliation compatibility as a wrapper.

findings.title: Large number of unlinked or low-discoverability pages/routes
findings.evidence: 7 pages were not found in the sampled navigation text.
findings.impact: Features may exist but be hard to discover, or dead pages may appear maintained.
findings.recommendedRepair: Perform navigation ownership pass; classify each page as ACTIVE, ADMIN, EXPERIMENTAL or DEPRECATED before deletion.

findings.title: Service responsibility duplication hotspots require consolidation plan
findings.evidence: settlement readiness: 8; result sync: 2; learning labels/evidence: 13; performance aggregation: 9; event identity/crosswalk: 7; sports registries: 28; operating date/timezone: 8
findings.impact: Duplicate responsibility increases bug-fix drift across product pages, scheduler, and APIs.
findings.recommendedRepair: Consolidate only after per-call-site contract review; start with settlement readiness and performance aggregation.

findings.title: Unused-service scan has many false-positive candidates that need owner classification
findings.evidence: 14 service files were not reached by simple static service import matching.
findings.impact: Some may be script-only, dynamic-imported, or dead; static count is not deletion evidence.
findings.recommendedRepair: Add owner/status front matter or registry comments for ACTIVE/SHADOW/PREVIEW/DEPRECATED services.

findings.title: MLB unresolved settlement backlog remains evidence-blocked
findings.impact: 67 MLB predictions remain pending until canonical result evidence exists.
findings.recommendedRepair: Continue canonical result ingestion recovery only; do not infer from sport_events alone.
